I went to this place for the good reviews but left so so disappointed.

- First, I dropped my car for a transmission issue on a Thursday morning (9am). They said they would call me the next day (they didn't call, not Friday, not Monday, I had to call them myself on Tuesday).
- Second, They then told me I have to pay $750 to get a diagnostic. I was like "wow that expensive" but since they had good reviews, I trusted that.
I paid, he then told me it will cost +$4k to fix it :).... I said I cant afford it, and that I want to pick up my car.
Guess what? The $750 I paid only covered taking the transmission out and doing the diagnostic, it didn't cover putting it back into the car???? what? Why didn't they mention that before? I had to get my car towed with the ignition, battery and filter in my trunk because they didn't put anything back in the place where it should be.

This was my personal experience, maybe other people got treated better, but I feel like I wasted my time and money.

I took my mom’s car to this shop, and it ended up being a complete nightmare. We waited nearly three months to get a call that the car was “fixed.” As soon as we picked it up, we had to turn right back around because it was having the exact same issues. Another month and a half went by before they called us again. This time the car was actually fixed, but by then, we had been without it for almost five months. There was no apology—just another bill for nearly $1,500 on top of what we had already paid. To make matters worse, the mechanic was aggressive and confrontational, and the owner was completely absent and did nothing to take accountability. Save yourself the trouble—take your car somewhere else.

Disappointing experience. We chose this shop based on the good reviews, and years of experience but my car still managed to have to be worked on for a whole month.
My vehicle was not fixed in a timely manner or even repaired correctly, I had to take it back two times. During this time I had to rent cars to get to and from work, I was only expecting to have to do this for about a week, so I was prepared for that since that seemed to be the average time frame for this type of repair.
My car was dropped off 3/04/25, I paid $515 to open up the transmission and diagnose.03/07 I paid half of the total to start the repairs & was told the car should be ready the next week 3/12-3/13. I was told it was ready Wednesday 3/19 so I paid the rest of the bill when I picked up my car. I droved 3 miles down the road when the check engine light came on & it was a transmission code so I drove it back to the shop.
David said he would get the mechanics to check it out and called back Tuesday 03/25 to let us know he needed to replace another part. 04/01 I picked up the car again and 04/04 while driving to work the check engine light came on once again. The following Tuesday 04/08 the car was finally fixed.

On a brighter note, the Manager David provided great customer service by being friendly, responsive and helpful.

Eagle transmission and Scot took advantage of us while having issues while traveling. We have been getting quotes from several shops around the area for a transmission swap.We have our own transmission and just need a professional to put it in.

Our average quotes have been between 750-900. Some with fluid included. We went to eagle transmission and they said a diagnostic would be 90$ unless we used his services. We expected his quote to be in the range of the previous. The front desk person initially said it’d take 4-6 hours. We decided to grab another vehicle and drop our problematic one off.

Under 20 minutes we got back to where we’re staying and I was messaged to call. He quoted me 2000 for labor and nothing included. Also said we needed to pay cash up front otherwise they wouldn’t work on it. Tried to pay the diagnostic fee with a card and he refused. Would only take cash. Seems like tax evasion to me.

Please don’t go here they will take advantage of you.

These people are jerks and will try to rip you off.

They didn't want to service my transmission and instead were trying to sell my a new one for $7,000.

I took it to another shop that changed the transmission fluid, now it's driving fine.

Scott, the owner, is the worst mechanic I have ever dealt with. He screens and dodges calls and emails, from both the client and the insurance company; lied and told me if I used him he would work with the insurance company on the labor rate (only to use his original rate); he is frequently “out of the office”; used the insurance check to order parts that were never received while attempting to refurbish my old parts - all during the holiday season might I add; he really didn’t know what he was doing on my car (disclosed 2 months into fixing it) only for each single thing he did on the car to take a week at a time to repair. When he did give notice it was always conveniently  on a Thursday or Friday that the next step would be the following week. Then he takes 3 months to fix my car and expects me to run and pick it up the next day! Meanwhile I’m spending money riding the bus and Uber and have a $2000 deductible that I have to pay him before I can ecen pick up my car. Like wow. No notice from the insurance company who was supposed to “approve my car” prior to me retaking possession of it. And on top of all this, he calls my finance to company to have my car repossessed because I couldn’t pick it up when he wanted me to!! No communication or explanation to me about anything regarding that decision. Very poor communication and business ethic as a mechanic and shop owner. I would never recommend this shop to anyone and pray that he learns a better way to do business.

An unauthorized 30 minute test drive resulted in switched brakes. I went to eagle transmission to get transmission service. Instead of them doing the transmission service, they felt the need to test drive my car without my permission. The driver was gone for over 30 minutes. I informed desk agent I was not okay with driver being gone for so long especially when i simply just came there to get transmission fluid changed. I told him to call driver to bring car back but he said he wasn't returning his calls. When I finally did get my car back the brakes were scratching really bad. I had quality expensive new brakes and rotors put on car a few months ago at different company but when I got my car back from eagle transmission test driving it for 30 plus minutes the brakes were scratching and rotor on driver side had deep groves in it. I asked them if they noticed anything wrong with car during that long test drive and they said no. I realized my front brakes and driver side rotor had been switched out. I now had really bad brake pads worn completely down on front but the rear were still new and thick. I feel this cant be an isolated incident.

Expensive rebuild only reason I had it replaced here is because my transmission failed,going to get price quotes here,and saw good stars. I need my only car fixed.Most of these reviews never had a transmission rebuilt.Hopefully the transmission last more then 12 months,There is no 5 year warranty as stated below on other review I saw.Did run into a couple trans hiccups,but so far it's running well.Update review pending.

Had them rebuild my original transmission in 02/15. Transmission broke in 11/15. UNDER THEIR NO COST WARRANTY, it took 11 phone calls on MY EFFORT, and 2.5mo to get my Jeep back AND it still leaks transmission fluid AND I had to replace my own crankshaft position sensor because they wouldn't (and still wont) return my phone calls or voicemails. I took delivery on 02/12/16. Why 11 phone calls on my part? I never received a phone call to discuss status, schedule or issues over the course of 2.5 months. I had to make visits to the shop just to get some answers and dates that were never met. I work in a professional office, and the least amount of customer service is talking to your client in the event that you have issues with a project. there are more details, but this are the basic facts. Be careful here, and get EVERYTHING in writing.

When the car got tow back to me I were excited until I drove it in the street I almost ran in the back of somebody car, the brake pedal touch the floor of my car, so I when to another shop got it done correctly and I seen all the dirty brakes fluid coming out going to a bottle, so I know Eagle transmission took my money and did not bleed my brake system, a waste of money

On 8/07/2013  I took my 2005 Chevrolet Malibu to the Inwood location at 3317 Inwood Rd STE 101 Dallas, Tx 75235 to ask them to look at a possible transmission issue i had.  After looking at my car and test driving it they determined it to have an oil leak that was leaking into the spark plugs causing them to fowl and misfire, which they also said could be causing the shifting issue on my car.  After paying $343.02 to have a new valve cover gasket and new spark plugs put on the car, I got my car back and drove home on the night of friday 8/09/2013 I noticed fluids dripping from underneath my car.  I looked and thought it was transmission fluid.  Saturday morning I drove my car back to the Eagle Transmission location on Inwood Rd and while waiting for them to open I looked under my hood and realized the fluids to actually be oil leaking from the valve cover (THE SAME VALVE COVER THEY SUPPOSEDLY FIXED) they looked at it and determined that they had some how cracked the valve cover during the repairs earlier and are repairing it, however I have been without my car or any transportation for 3 days now, and they have offered no accommodations for my inconvenience.  By the way my car was supposed to be ready by 3:30 today 8/13/2013 it is now going on 4pm and I have received no call what so ever.  This is the worse I have ever had to deal with with any repair shop.  Also no one has offered to replace the expensive mobile one oil that was in my car from a very recent oil change done one week prior (SEPARATE OIL AND LUBE CENTER)

Not sure I would go here. Called to get quote on transmission flush. Mechanic said they empty pan and change filter. This transmission the filter is built in and is not replaced with normal service. Plus cost was almost double of dealership.

I cannot speak on the work that the shop performs but they do not allow parts that are not provided by their shop.  Even if the parts are not carried by them. I was offered a three-hour testing to identify possible issues which I do not require. The dealer provided a printout of required work needed. At some point I hope this policy, that is not listed on their website is either posted or changed.
